name: Somtum Jinda Fairview (CF Fairview Mall)
address: Front of T&T, 1800 Sheppard Ave E
description: Somtum Jinda specializes in Isaan (Northeastern Thai) cuisine. Located in front of T&T Supermarket inside CF Fairview Mall. Only the Gerrard Street (Downtown) and Fairview locations are part of Naguk Group; the brand's Kensington Market location (356 College St) is run independently and is NOT managed by Naguk Group. Two gift-card links exist on the brand site, but which one maps to which specific location could not be confirmed.
